metadata.title: अंधविश्वास में फँसा आदिवासी | Weekly Tribal Bulletin
metadata.description:
In this bulletin, we will begin with serious issues like superstition and the need for awareness. Next, we will delve into the key points of the meeting held in Tripura under the Tiprasa Agreement.

We’ll also provide insights into the ongoing eviction campaign in Assam, focusing on the tribal belt and block laws. Additionally, we'll share an inspiring story of a tribal woman who has set a new precedent by becoming an Assistant Loco Pilot on the Vande Bharat Express.

Finally, we’ll take a look at the controversy surrounding the Sarna religion in Jharkhand and the demands for tribal identity. Stay tuned and share your thoughts on these important topics!

#Superstition #Tiprasa #Assam #TribalWoman #Jharkhand #SarnaReligion
